edges.reason: constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender, so the deployer becomes the privileged owner.
constructor reads msg.sender to establish the initial owner.
onlyOwner gates ownershipTransfer by comparing msg.sender to owner.
ownershipTransfer reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
ownershipTransfer writes owner from the _owner parameter.
ownershipTransfer mutates the owner state variable.
initialize is protected by onlyOwner.
initialize stores _handlerID into the handlerID state variable.
initialize stores handlerAddr into the delegatecall target state variable handler.
initialize stores marketManagerAddr into marketManager, which controls the onlyMarketManager check.
initialize stores interestModelAddr into interestModelInstance.
initialize stores marketDataStorageAddr into handlerDataStorage.
initialize stores erc20Addr into erc20Instance, controlling which token the proxy moves.
initialize stores _tokenName into tokenName.
initialize stores siHandlerAddr into the SI delegatecall target.
initialize stores SIHandlerDataStorageAddr into SIHandlerDataStorage.
setHandlerID is protected by onlyOwner.
setHandlerID parameter flows into the function body.
setHandlerID overwrites the handlerID state variable.
setHandlerAddr is protected by onlyOwner.
setHandlerAddr parameter flows into the function body.
setHandlerAddr overwrites the delegatecall target handler.
setSiHandlerAddr is protected by onlyOwner.
setSiHandlerAddr parameter flows into the function body.
setSiHandlerAddr overwrites the delegatecall target SI.
getHandlerID returns the handlerID state variable.
getHandlerAddr returns the handler state variable.
getSiHandlerAddr returns the SI state variable.
migration is protected by onlyOwner.
migration reads erc20Instance to query the proxy token balance.
migration stores the proxy balance into the local balance variable.
migration passes the full contract balance into the token transfer.
migration sends the drained balance to the owner-supplied target parameter.
migration invokes erc20Instance.transfer.
deposit delegatecalls into the handler address, letting external handler logic re-enter proxy storage and state.
deposit uses the DEPOSIT signature string to build delegatecall calldata.
deposit encodes the user-supplied amount into the delegatecall calldata.
deposit encodes the user-supplied flag into the delegatecall calldata.
deposit forwards user-influenced calldata into the delegatecall to handler.
deposit stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
deposit stores the delegatecall return data in returnData for the require string.
withdraw delegatecalls into the handler, enabling external code execution and potential reentrancy.
withdraw encodes the user-supplied amount into the delegatecall calldata.
withdraw encodes the user-supplied flag into the delegatecall calldata.
withdraw forwards user-influenced calldata into the delegatecall to handler.
withdraw stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
withdraw stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.
borrow delegatecalls into the handler, exposing proxy state to reentrant external logic.
borrow encodes the user-supplied amount into the delegatecall calldata.
borrow encodes the user-supplied flag into the delegatecall calldata.
borrow forwards user-influenced calldata into the delegatecall to handler.
borrow stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
borrow stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.
repay delegatecalls into the handler, allowing reentrant execution inside proxy context.
repay encodes the user-supplied amount into the delegatecall calldata.
repay encodes the user-supplied flag into the delegatecall calldata.
repay forwards user-influenced calldata into the delegatecall to handler.
repay stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
repay stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.
handlerProxy is gated by onlyMarketManager, restricting msg.sender to marketManager or owner.
onlyMarketManager compares msg.sender against the marketManager state variable.
onlyMarketManager copies msg.sender into the msgSender local variable.
handlerProxy passes fully caller-controlled calldata into the local data buffer.
handlerProxy delegatecalls caller-supplied calldata into the handler, executing arbitrary logic in proxy storage.
handlerProxy forwards caller-controlled calldata to the delegatecall.
handlerProxy stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
handlerProxy stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.
handlerViewProxy accepts unauthenticated caller-controlled calldata.
handlerViewProxy delegatecalls arbitrary calldata into handler without any access modifier, so any external account can drive state-changing delegatecalls.
handlerViewProxy forwards caller-controlled calldata to the delegatecall.
handlerViewProxy stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
handlerViewProxy stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.
siProxy is gated by onlyMarketManager.
siProxy uses the owner-controlled SI address as delegatecall target.
siProxy passes caller-controlled calldata into the local data buffer.
siProxy delegatecalls caller-supplied calldata into SI, executing untrusted logic in proxy storage.
siProxy forwards caller-controlled calldata to the delegatecall.
siProxy stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
siProxy stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.
siViewProxy uses the owner-controlled SI address as delegatecall target.
siViewProxy accepts unauthenticated caller-controlled calldata.
siViewProxy delegatecalls arbitrary calldata into SI without an access modifier, allowing any caller to trigger state-changing delegatecalls.
siViewProxy forwards caller-controlled calldata to the delegatecall.
siViewProxy stores the delegatecall success flag in result.
siViewProxy stores the delegatecall return data in returnData.

normalization_plan.reason: initialize parameter _handlerID is only meaningful as input to initialize.
initialize parameter handlerAddr feeds the handler state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter marketManagerAddr feeds the marketManager state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter interestModelAddr feeds the interestModelInstance state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter marketDataStorageAddr feeds the handlerDataStorage state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter erc20Addr feeds the erc20Instance state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter _tokenName feeds the tokenName state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter siHandlerAddr feeds the SI state variable set in initialize.
initialize parameter SIHandlerDataStorageAddr feeds the SIHandlerDataStorage state variable set in initialize.
ownershipTransfer parameter _owner is the new owner value written by ownershipTransfer.
setHandlerID parameter _handlerID is written to the handlerID state variable by setHandlerID.
setHandlerAddr parameter handlerAddr is written to the handler state variable by setHandlerAddr.
setSiHandlerAddr parameter siHandlerAddr is written to the SI state variable by setSiHandlerAddr.
migration parameter target is the recipient consumed by the erc20Instance.transfer unsafe operation.
deposit parameter unifiedTokenAmount is encoded into the delegatecall calldata for the handler deposit unsafe operation.
deposit parameter flag only controls the deposit function call mode.
withdraw parameter unifiedTokenAmount is encoded into the delegatecall calldata for the handler withdraw unsafe operation.
withdraw parameter flag only controls the withdraw function call mode.
borrow parameter unifiedTokenAmount is encoded into the delegatecall calldata for the handler borrow unsafe operation.
borrow parameter flag only controls the borrow function call mode.
repay parameter unifiedTokenAmount is encoded into the delegatecall calldata for the handler repay unsafe operation.
repay parameter flag only controls the repay function call mode.
handlerProxy parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the handler delegatecall unsafe operation.
handlerViewProxy parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the handler delegatecall unsafe operation.
siProxy parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the SI delegatecall unsafe operation.
siViewProxy parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the SI delegatecall unsafe operation.
local result holds the success flag of the handler delegatecall performed by deposit and the other proxy entry points.
local returnData holds the handler delegatecall revert data surfaced by require after the deposit delegatecall.
local data holds the abi.encodeWithSignature or raw calldata buffer that is passed into the handler delegatecall unsafe operation.
migration local balance is the amount fed into the erc20Instance.transfer unsafe operation.
